description: This file defines the TemporaryQueryGuard class which adds access control mechanisms to entity queries within Drupal's JSON:API module. It manages access restrictions based on user permissions, entity states, and specific entity types, including comments and files, to ensure secure data querying.

classes.name: TemporaryQueryGuard
classes.description: A class providing static methods to enforce access controls on entity queries in Drupal's JSON:API module, including handling of user permissions, entity states, and special cases like comments and files.

methods.name: setFieldManager
methods.description: Sets the static entity field manager used for access control logic.

methods.name: setModuleHandler
methods.description: Sets the static module handler used for invoking module hooks.

methods.name: applyAccessControls
methods.description: Main method to apply access controls to a given entity query based on filters.

methods.name: secureQuery
methods.description: Recursively applies security conditions to an entity query based on entity type and field conditions.

methods.name: applyAccessConditions
methods.description: Adds access-related conditions to an entity query, respecting user permissions and entity states.

methods.name: addConditionFieldPrefix
methods.description: Prefixes all fields in an EntityConditionGroup with a specified field prefix.

methods.name: getAccessCondition
methods.description: Generates access conditions for an entity type, including special handling for core entity types.

methods.name: getAccessConditionForKnownSubsets
methods.description: Creates conditions based on allowed subsets like published, enabled, or owner, for filtering entities.

methods.name: getAccessResultsFromEntityFilterHook
methods.description: Invokes hooks to gather access results from modules for different entity filter subsets.

methods.name: getCommentAccessCondition
methods.description: Builds access conditions for comment entities based on referenced entity permissions.

methods.name: alwaysFalse
methods.description: Returns an entity condition group that is always false, used to block access.

methods.name: collectFilteredFields
methods.description: Recursively collects all fields used in entity query conditions.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Builds a nested tree structure from an array of field paths, used for query condition parsing.
